risks.title: Cloud administrator takeover
risks.statement: Because standing admin rights and long-lived keys exist, an attacker with one stolen credential could take control of AWS production, leading to data theft, payment disruption and regulatory action.
risks.technique: T1552.001 Credentials In Files; T1078.004 Cloud Accounts
risks.existing: Okta SSO with MFA; AWS SSO; Okta super admins cut to two (QW-04)

risks.title: Credential phishing of engineers
risks.statement: Because staff are not drilled and some devices are unprotected, a phishing email could capture an engineer's credentials, giving an attacker a foothold in internal systems.
risks.existing: Okta MFA; annual awareness training; security report channel (QW-08)

risks.title: Password attacks on tools outside Okta
risks.statement: Because Metabase, Jenkins and OpenVPN do not enforce MFA, reused or guessed passwords could give an attacker access to production data and deployment jobs.
risks.existing: MFA now enforced on Kyrovia and agent Zendesk logins (QW-03); password rules on each tool

risks.title: Ransomware destroys production data and backups
risks.statement: Because backups share the production account, an attacker with admin access could delete them and encrypt data, causing a long outage and loss of customer funds records.
risks.technique: T1486 Data Encrypted for Impact; T1490 Inhibit System Recovery
risks.existing: Daily AWS backups; Multi-AZ; EDR on enrolled laptops; one full restore recorded (QW-07)

risks.title: Intrusion goes undetected
risks.statement: Because logs are unreviewed and there is no SIEM, an intrusion could continue for weeks, increasing losses and delaying regulatory reporting.
risks.existing: CloudTrail now on in all five accounts (QW-01); availability alerting

risks.title: Former staff retain access
risks.statement: Because access removal relies on manual steps, a leaver or mover could keep working credentials and misuse data or systems.
risks.existing: 24-hour leaver rule with same-day HR notice (QW-06); Okta deprovisioning

risks.title: Insider exfiltrates customer data
risks.statement: Because engineers and analysts can read production personal data and exports raise no alert, an insider could take customer data, leading to a reportable breach and loss of trust.
risks.technique: T1213 Data from Information Repositories; T1567.002 Exfiltration to Cloud Storage; T1052.001 Exfiltration over USB
risks.existing: Role-based access through Okta; NDAs; pre-employment screening

risks.title: Card data exposed in support tickets
risks.statement: Because customers paste card numbers into tickets, cardholder data could build up outside the card vault and be exposed through the support desk.
risks.existing: 11 tickets purged and redaction enabled (QW-02); agent MFA (QW-03); card vault held by Tessarin

risks.title: Unreviewed or malicious change reaches production
risks.statement: Because the deployment path can be bypassed, a rushed or malicious change could reach the payment platform, causing outage, fraud or data loss.
risks.technique: T1565.001 Stored Data Manipulation; T1657 Financial Theft
risks.existing: Branch protection on all production repositories (QW-05); peer review; CI pipeline

risks.title: Compromised dependency or build pipeline
risks.statement: Because dependencies are not inventoried or scanned, a poisoned package or build tool could run in production with full privileges.
risks.technique: T1195.001 Compromise Software Dependencies and Development Tools
risks.existing: GitHub behind Okta; dependency updates by each team

risks.title: Exploitation of legacy internet-facing services
risks.statement: Because old OpenVPN and Jenkins hosts lag on patches, an attacker could exploit them to reach database subnets.
risks.technique: T1190 Exploit Public-Facing Application; T1133 External Remote Services
risks.existing: Annual penetration test; security groups

risks.title: Breach at the KYC provider exposes identity documents
risks.statement: Because Kyrovia holds identity documents and has never been assessed, a breach there could expose customer identities, and Orvanta would remain accountable.
risks.existing: Data processing agreement and NDA; supplier controls unverified

risks.title: Card processor outage or failure
risks.statement: Because card issuing depends on one unassessed processor with no exit plan, a Tessarin failure could stop the card program for days.
risks.existing: Contract with service levels; no assurance report on file

risks.title: Support provider misuse or compromise
risks.statement: Because Helvora agents handle customer data under unassessed controls, a compromised or careless agent could expose or alter customer records.
risks.existing: Contract and NDA; named Okta accounts for Orbit; agent MFA (QW-03)

risks.title: Payment file tampering on the bank connection
risks.statement: Because one person can prepare and release payout files, a fraudulent or altered file could move client money to the wrong accounts.
risks.technique: T1565.001 Stored Data Manipulation; T1657 Financial Theft
risks.existing: Bank tokens for the portal; SFTP key in Secrets Manager; daily reconciliation

risks.title: AWS region outage stops payments
risks.statement: Because all production runs in one AWS region, a regional failure could stop payments for more than a day.
risks.existing: Multi-AZ across three availability zones; autoscaling

risks.title: Restore fails after data loss
risks.statement: Because restores are not tested on a schedule, a real recovery could fail or take far longer than the business can tolerate.
risks.existing: Daily backups and snapshots; one full restore recorded (QW-07)

risks.title: Incident mishandled and reporting duties missed
risks.statement: Because the incident plan is untested, a serious incident could be contained slowly and reported late to regulators and customers.
risks.existing: PagerDuty on-call for outages; incident call list (QW-08); 2023 draft plan

risks.title: Unmanaged laptop lost or stolen
risks.statement: Because 43 laptops are not centrally managed, a lost device could expose source code, credentials and customer data.
risks.existing: Disk encryption and remote wipe on 88 enrolled laptops

risks.title: Personal data accessed from Baku without transfer safeguards
risks.statement: Because Baku engineers can view production personal data without a documented assessment, Orvanta could breach GDPR transfer rules.
risks.existing: Intra-group agreement; access through AWS SSO

risks.title: DDoS against the Merchant Payment API
risks.statement: Because merchants depend on a public API, a large attack could slow or block payments for a short period.
risks.existing: Cloudflare DDoS protection and WAF; autoscaling; capacity monitoring

risks.title: Session theft from an unmanaged device
risks.statement: Because unmanaged laptops lack EDR, malware could steal a live session and bypass MFA.
risks.existing: Okta session policies; EDR on enrolled laptops

risks.title: MFA fatigue attack on staff
risks.statement: Because push approval is the main second factor, repeated prompts could trick a user into approving an attacker's login.
risks.existing: Okta push MFA; super admins cut to two (QW-04)

risks.title: API logic flaw enables payment fraud
risks.statement: Because security requirements and tests are not built into delivery, a logic flaw in the payment API could be abused to move money.
risks.technique: T1190 Exploit Public-Facing Application; T1133 External Remote Services
risks.existing: Peer code review; annual penetration test; Cloudflare WAF

risks.title: Live personal data in test environments
risks.statement: Because masking is not enforced, real customer data could reach staging, where controls are weaker.
risks.existing: Masked exports are the norm; separate AWS accounts

risks.title: Unowned assets left unprotected
risks.statement: Because there is no complete asset register, devices and SaaS tools could sit outside patching, monitoring and offboarding.
risks.existing: Terraform inventory for cloud; Jamf inventory for 88 laptops

risks.title: Key-person dependency in the security team
risks.statement: Because two people carry all security work, the loss of one could stall the program and slow incident response.
risks.existing: CISO-designate and one security engineer; SRE on-call rota

risks.title: Certification missed and enterprise revenue lost
risks.statement: Because the ISMS must be built and operated within 12 months, slippage could miss the deadline and lose EUR 2.4M of annual enterprise revenue.
risks.existing: CEO sponsorship; approved roadmap; monthly steering meeting

risks.title: DORA ICT risk duties not met
risks.statement: Because the ICT risk framework and third-party register are incomplete, supervisory review could find Orvanta in breach of DORA.
risks.existing: Compliance obligations list; working contact with the supervisor

risks.title: Bulk data theft from cloud storage
risks.statement: Because storage and databases are broadly readable inside AWS, an intruder could copy KYC files and transaction data at scale.
risks.existing: KMS encryption at rest; private subnets; IAM roles
